start: Gym tab, joined gym that keeps plans in MettleUp, member with a running plan, online

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and tap 'My gym'
user_sees: Card headed 'MY MEMBERSHIP' with the plan name as title
'Ends <date> · <n> days left' (amber with 'Renew at the desk before it ends.' when 7 days or less and no next plan)
'<n> days at the gym this month.' or 'No days at the gym yet this month.'
must_not: Another member's plan on the card
'1 days' for one day
A day count that leaves out the last paid day

steps.action: Leave the tab and come back
user_sees: The card read again from the gym; the same plan, or the new one after a desk change
must_not: An old plan kept on screen after the desk renewed it

start: Gym tab, joined member the gym's list cannot match

steps.action: Open 'My gym' when the member never checked in
user_sees: Title 'Check in once to link your membership'
'Scan <gym>'s check-in QR at the gym once. Then your plan or pass, and your visits, show here.'
must_not: A blank card or an error code
Another member's plan picked by name

steps.action: Open 'My gym' when two members share the mobile number
user_sees: Title 'Your number is shared'
'More than one <gym> member has this mobile number. Ask the desk to give each person their own.'
must_not: The other person's plan shown

steps.action: Open 'My gym' when the gym does not keep plans in MettleUp
user_sees: Title 'Not available yet' and '<gym> doesn't keep its members' plans in MettleUp yet. Ask the desk.'
must_not: A made-up 'No plan yet'

start: Gym tab, member whose plan has ended, then renewed at the desk

steps.action: Open 'My gym' after the plan's last day
user_sees: Title 'Your plan has ended'
'Ended <date>'
'Renew at the desk to keep training.'
must_not: The ended plan shown as active
Pause or renew rows that act on the ended plan

steps.action: Desk renews; member pulls or reopens the tab
user_sees: The new plan's name and 'Ends <date> · <n> days left'
A next plan shows as 'Next: <plan>, from <date>.' when it starts later
must_not: 'Your plan has ended' left on screen
The ends-soon reminder still set after the renewal

start: Gym tab, no internet at the gym, plan read earlier today

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open 'My gym'
user_sees: The kept plan, and 'No internet. As of <time> today.'
No 'Pause my plan', 'Renew my plan', report or pay rows on the kept card
must_not: A card that vanishes with no signal
Pause or renew buttons that cannot send

steps.action: Open it on a later day still offline
user_sees: 'No internet. As of an earlier day: ask the desk if unsure.'
must_not: The kept card claiming it is current

start: Gym tab, member who left one gym and joined another on the same phone

steps.action: Open 'My gym' for the new gym
user_sees: Only this member's plan at the new gym, or nothing until the new gym answers
must_not: The old gym's plan, name or visits on the card
The kept plan of the member who used the phone before

start: Gym tab, member who trains with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass) at a gym that keeps plans

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and tap 'My gym'
user_sees: Title '<pass> member'
'You train at <gym> with <pass>. There is no plan to renew.'
'Scan the gym's check-in QR when you arrive. The gym counts it as a <pass> visit.'
must_not: An end date or 'Renew at the desk' line
'Pause my plan' or 'Renew my plan' buttons

start: Gym tab, pass member whose key the gym no longer knows

steps.action: Open 'My gym' after the gym removed the phone
user_sees: No 'My membership' card
must_not: The kept pass card under 'No internet' when the phone is online
A raw error on screen

start: Gym tab, pass member whose old plan is still running

user_sees: The pass card, not the plan
No ends-soon warning
must_not: The old plan's end date shown as a renewal need
The Workout tab's 'Your plan ends' card

start: Gym tab, a pass member at a gym

user_sees: Only own pass and own visits
must_not: Another member's pass, name or visits
The pass company's own data
